meta.description: Sequence-based deep learning for ATAC-seq using chromBPNet, BPNet, scBasset, or Enformer: Tn5 bias correction, per-base accessibility profiles, in silico variant effects, and DeepLIFT/TF-MoDISco motif discovery.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated citations or results; uncited speed/compute claims are scored under maintainability.

practice_boundaries.detail: Research analysis scope; no diagnostic or therapeutic conclusions.

methodological_ground.detail: Input 2: documented log2FC on the log-count head understates effects about 5x (mean -0.46 vs true -2.27), so the |log2fc|>1 rule would call strong effects weak (DLA-001).

code_usability.detail: Input 1: shipped pipeline script fails at once because the required nonpeaks file is never generated; documented variants.tsv and pred_bw region formats also fail (DLA-002, DLA-003, DLA-007).

functional_suitability.note: Core chromBPNet and modisco pieces work, but variant, motif and scBasset/Enformer/Borzoi routes are missing steps or wrong as written.

reliability.note: No input checks; missing nonpeaks and column-format failures surface as raw stack traces and the slow interpret stage is unmentioned.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md 88 lines with three focused references; compute figures uncited.

agent_usability.note: Tool-selection guidance is clear but several documented commands cannot be followed cold; inconsistent scBasset and bias-model statements.

human_usability.note: Good triggers and a when-not-to-use list; rigid undocumented input formats.

security.note: No secrets or destructive commands; unquoted variables and placeholder path unvalidated.

maintainability.note: Clean routing; only one runnable script and no tests or examples.

agent_specific.note: Strong progressive disclosure and routing; re-run of prep nonpeaks fails on existing outputs; escape hatches only partly stated.

key_strengths: Clear tool-selection guidance and when-not-to-use boundaries that keep classical ATAC steps out of scope.
Correct current-CLI details in places (chrombpnet prep splits flags, snp_score removed, variant-scorer companion repo).
Concise SKILL.md with routed references and a shipped end-to-end script skeleton.
Core tooling verified live: pretrained ENCODE model separates real peaks (AUC 0.970); variant-scorer logfc exact; modisco recovers a planted motif.

recommendations.title: DLA-001 log2FC formula understates effects ~5x on log-count
recommendations.problem: `np.log2(y_alt.sum(-1)/y_ref.sum(-1))` is a ratio of LOG counts, not a count fold change.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: State the head semantics (chromBPNet outputs profile logits + log counts). Compute (y_alt - y_ref)/ln2 on the log-count head (or log2 of exp-counts), or use variant-scorer's logfc; wrap tuple outputs with CountWrapper; add a numeric regression using a planted motif.

recommendations.title: DLA-002 Shipped pipeline not runnable as documented (no nonp
recommendations.problem: The script consumes NONPEAKS (default nonpeaks.bed) but nothing generates it; neither SKILL.md nor the script mentions `chrombpnet prep nonpeaks`.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Add a `chrombpnet prep nonpeaks -g -c -p -fl -o` step before step 2 (documented output `<prefix>_negatives.bed`), wire it to NONPEAKS, check inputs exist up front, and document the stage runtimes.

recommendations.title: DLA-003 variants.tsv format and pybedtools prerequisite wron
recommendations.problem: Documented `chrom, pos, ref, alt` (4 columns) fails in variant-scorer: `ValueError: File has 4 columns but chrombpnet schema expects 5 columns`.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Document the 5-column schema with an example row, name the output columns, and list pybedtools (conda) as a prerequisite.

recommendations.title: DLA-004 tangermeme route for chromBPNet models has no loader
recommendations.problem: The SKILL/decision tree route variants through 'tangermeme on pre-trained chromBPNet' but `load_chrombpnet_model` is pseudocode and `tangermeme.io.adapter` does not exist (tangermeme 1.5.0 io exposes read_meme/read_vcf/extract_loci etc.).
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Route chromBPNet/ENCODE .h5 variant scoring to variant-scorer; keep tangermeme for torch models (bpnet-lite, bpnetlite.chrombpnet) with a working loader example; remove the 100x-speed claim or cite it.

recommendations.title: DLA-005 chromBPNet-to-modisco route documented incorrectly
recommendations.problem: The reference says `chrombpnet contribs_bw` writes hypothetical contributions to be converted 'via shap_to_modisco'; no such tool exists in chrombpnet 1.0.1.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Document the actual chromBPNet route (interpret output or a working DeepSHAP-to-npz conversion), the (N,4,L) layout, the tomtom/MEME prerequisite and expected CPU runtime, and add an executed example.

recommendations.title: DLA-006 Version claims (TF 2.13+) unsatisfiable for chromBPN
recommendations.problem: chrombpnet 1.0.1 pins tensorflow 2.8.0/keras 2.8/numpy 1.23/python 3.8 (CPU only; libcudart 11 missing, sm_120 unsupported); scBasset training fails on Keras 3 (`ModelCheckpoint filepath must end in .weights.h5`) and needs TF<=2.15; modisco-lite is the PyPI name (chromBPNet env carries 2.0.7, Skill .
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Document separate environments per tool (chromBPNet TF 2.8/py3.8 CPU; torch stack for bpnet-lite/tangermeme/modisco; scBasset TF<=2.15), correct the pins and the 'GPU required' claim for chromBPNet.

recommendations.title: DLA-007 pred_bw regions need 10-column narrowPeak
recommendations.problem: `chrombpnet pred_bw -r regions.bed` with a natural 3-column BED fails `ValueError: cannot convert float NaN to integer`; a 10-column narrowPeak (summit column) works and produced pred_bias.bw / pred_chrombpnet_nobias.bw (bias track sum 421.5 vs corrected 17,923.6 in regions, 60,959 non-zero bins).
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: State the 10-column requirement and give a one-line way to derive it from peaks.narrowPeak.

recommendations.title: DLA-008 Uncalibrated |log2FC|>1 threshold; tool null ignored
recommendations.problem: The Skill declares |log2fc|>1 'strong effect' with no calibration.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Recommend the shuffled-null p-values and jsd, describe how to pick thresholds, and label |log2FC|>1 as a heuristic.

recommendations.title: DLA-009 No model QC acceptance criteria after training
recommendations.problem: No step checks bias-model or corrected-model quality.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Add a QC gate (bias/corrected metrics, footprint and max bias response, `chrombpnet qc`) with pass/fail guidance before variant or motif use.

recommendations.title: DLA-010 Enformer/Borzoi/scBasset advice unsupported or contr
recommendations.problem: 'Kipoi for Enformer' is false (kipoi ls shows no Enformer; Enformer works via enformer-pytorch/HF: real 196,608 bp hg38 -> (1,896,5313) finite).
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Give a working Enformer command (enformer-pytorch) with input-length and track guidance, drop or qualify Borzoi, and rewrite the scBasset guidance around per-cell input with prerequisites and versions.

recommendations.title: DLA-011 CPU stage runtime undocumented; DeepSHAP stage never
recommendations.problem: `chrombpnet bias pipeline` (two runs, 61-76 min) and `chrombpnet pipeline` (step 3, capped at 3,600 s, log ends 'Generating profile shap scores / Done 0 examples of 2165' at 60m01s) did not exit in the post-training DeepSHAP interpret stage on CPU under load; the interpret directories hold only args.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Document that interpretation is the slow tail, how to reduce/skip it, and per-stage runtimes; keep the 'exit not observed' limitation until rerun on suitable hardware.

recommendations.title: DLA-012 Stale or non-existent flags and terms
recommendations.problem: `--num-filters` is `-fil/--filters`; `target_seqlet_fdr` and 'flank_size' are TF-MoDISco v1 terms not exposed by modisco-lite 2.x (`-f` seqlet flank; no FDR flag); 'DeepLIFT (RevealCancel rule)' conflicts with the stated rescale default; 'bias trained on naked-DNA control' conflicts with the pipelin.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Replace each with the installed CLI's names and reconcile the bias-model statements.

recommendations.title: DLA-013 Script hygiene: unquoted paths, placeholder scorer p
recommendations.problem: Variables are unquoted (paths with spaces break); VARIANT_SCORER defaults to `/path/to/variant-scorer` with no existence check, so a placeholder failure would surface only after the long training; `-tcr/-vcr` are test/valid but the header says train/val/test order; step 4 says the `variants.tsv` con.
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
recommendations.fix: Quote variables, fail fast on missing inputs and scorer path, and fix the comment.

recommendations.title: DLA-014 Unsupported comparative claims and thresholds
recommendations.problem: 'Strongest bias correction of the compared tools', '100x speedup', '<50M reads / <30k peaks' and the compute figures are uncited; bounded runs cannot confirm them..
recommendations.root_cause: Reference examples were written from tool documentation without executing them against installed versions.
